subject: dym-ft
title: DYM.FT.------C.FO.ACT.
description: Second diagram on page 450, paired with INFO-DY × ALT-FT above. This one crosses DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism — what alternative form *does* in working motion) with C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). DYM-FT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) rises above as the subject's upward output, with METH branching from it. INFO-DY hangs below DYM-FT as the subject's working hub: IST-F (isolated focus) branches left from it and MT-INFO (multi-information) branches down-right, with DEF (definition) branching from MT-INFO to the right margin. C-FO-ACT sits at the lower end of the main line as partner. CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) rises from the main line to the upper-right; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branches from CULT-SOLD, and PART (participation) rises from RT-ALGN to the upper-right.
